name: Aberrant Return
oracle_text: Put one, two, or three target creature cards from graveyards onto the battlefield under your control. Each of them enters with an additional -1/-1 counter on it.
blocked_sentences: Put one, two, or three target creature cards from graveyards onto the battlefield under your control.

needs.what: a target spec whose size the caster picks between a printed floor and ceiling -- "one, two, or three target creature cards" is 1..3, never 0 -- e.g. a `min_count: 1` beside `count: 3, up_to: true`, so the spell cannot be cast with no targets (601.2c) and enumerate_target_tuples offers subsets of size 3, 2 and 1 but not the empty one
needs.why_existing_wont_do: target `up_to` is "zero to N" (targeting.py always appends the empty subset and loader/targets.py documents it as such), so it lets the sorcery be cast with no targets and with no creature card in any graveyard; a fixed `count: 3` without up_to forces exactly min(3, candidates) and never lets the caster choose one or two when three are available. The rest of the card is expressible: a `card_in_graveyard` target with selector {types: [Creature], zone: graveyard, controller: any} and `return_from_graveyard` with destination battlefield, controller you, counters {"-1/-1": 1}
